diagnosis: The middleware blindly extracts x-organization-id from HTTP request headers into req.locals.orgId without verifying whether the authenticated user (req.user) is a member of that organization. An attacker can set arbitrary organization IDs to view revenue analytics of other companies.
exploit_request:
GET /api/analytics/monthly HTTP/1.1
Host: app.metrics.io
Authorization: Bearer <valid_jwt>
x-organization-id: org_competitor_corp_5910
